keywords: Partition action – Statement of claim – Failure to annex pedigree – Whether non-compliance is fatal – Statutory requirement interpreted as directory rather than invariably mandatory – Court’s inherent power to cure procedural defect – Partition action sui generis – Duty to investigate title independently – Rights in rem – Court should not allow technical omission to prevent investigation of competing title – Interlocutory decree and proper investigation of title.
legistation: Partition Law No. 21 of 1977 – sections 19(1), 25 and 79; provisions corresponding to sections 4–7 concerning procedural compliance; principles of inherent jurisdiction and investigation of title.
